title: Practice 1: Doing it fully, to the end

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: What does о- add in ослабе́ть?
options: the limit, completeness, result of an action
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists ослабе́ть under this meaning of о-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 7 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).

exercises.q: What does о- add in осле́пнуть?
options: the limit, completeness, result of an action
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists осле́пнуть under this meaning of о-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 7 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).

exercises.q: What does от- add in отде́лать?
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists отде́лать under this meaning of от-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «от-», meaning 3 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/от-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to carry out, to implement, to accomplish, to fulfill, to execute, to perform
to clear up, to elucidate, to clarify, to find out, to ascertain
to weaken, to become weaker, to become/grow weak
to become/go blind, to lose one's sight
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вы́полнить — to carry out, to implement, to accomplish, to fulfill, to execute, to perform; вы́яснить — to clear up, to elucidate, to clarify, to find out, to ascertain; ослабе́ть — to weaken, to become weaker, to become/grow weak; осле́пнуть — to become/go blind, to lose one's sight.

exercises.q: The dress was trimmed with lace.
exercises.why: **отделано** — отде́лать (perfective): to finish, to trim (up); to trim (with); (colloquial) to spoil, to ruin; (colloquial) to beat, to wallop, to lick, to give the works, to give the business, to tan someone's hide. Wiktionary: от- + де́лать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does про- add in проговори́ть?
options: completeness, exhaustion or thoroughness of an action
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists проговори́ть under this meaning of про-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «про-», meaning 4 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/про-).
**проговорили** — проговори́ть (perfective): to say, to utter; to talk (for a while). Wiktionary: про- + говори́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to enhance, to upgrade, to improve, to refine
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: отде́лать — to finish, to trim (up); проговори́ть — to say, to utter; ужа́лить — (of insects) to sting; усоверше́нствовать — to enhance, to upgrade, to improve, to refine.

exercises.q: We stayed up talking until four in the morning.
exercises.why: **проговорили** — проговори́ть (perfective): to say, to utter; to talk (for a while). Wiktionary: про- + говори́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does у- add in ужа́лить?
options: destroying or using up the object by the action of the base verb
completing the action of the base verb, bringing it to a result or to exhaustive fullness
settling or placing something thoroughly, comfortably or for long
moving away from, leaving a place by the action of the base verb
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists ужа́лить under this meaning of у-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «у-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/у-).

exercises.q: What does у- add in усоверше́нствовать?
options: making the object as many times bigger as the base numeral says
destroying or using up the object by the action of the base verb
moving away from, leaving a place by the action of the base verb
completing the action of the base verb, bringing it to a result or to exhaustive fullness
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists усоверше́нствовать under this meaning of у-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «у-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/у-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to conceal, to keep to oneself, to keep a secret
to have breakfast, to breakfast, to lunch
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: утаи́ть — to conceal, to keep to oneself, to keep a secret; поза́втракать — to have breakfast, to breakfast, to lunch; подписа́ть — to sign (one's own name); напи́ться — to quench thirst.
